swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: MC33202DR2G is limited to 12 V max (13 V abs max, p.3) whereas TL082IDR supports up to 40 V (42 V abs max, p.9). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (MC33202DR2G: IN=RR, OUT=RR vs TL082IDR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 20x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs TL082IDR: 20 V/µs p.16); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 1231x (MC33202DR2G: 80000 pA p.3 vs TL082IDR: 65 pA p.14); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: MC33202DR2G has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (13 V, p.3) than TL082IDR (42 V, p.9); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 13 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 29% higher on MC33202DR2G (MC33202DR2G: 190 °C/W p.5 vs TL082IDR: 147.8 °C/W p.10); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TL082IDR requires Vs,min >= 4.5 V (p.9) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (MC33202DR2G: -40..105 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 105°C) vs TL082IDR: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C)); TL082IDR hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and TL082IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; slew rate differs 20x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 2.2 MHz (p.4) vs 5.25 MHz (p.14), supply ceiling 12 V (p.1) vs 40 V (p.9), Vos 8 mV (p.3) vs 6 mV (p.14), Ib 1231x gap (80000 vs 65 pA), voltage noise 20 vs 37 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: MC33202DR2G "Internal Back-to-Back Differential Input Clamp Diodes Limit Comparator Use" (p.3) and TL082IDR "Mixed Legacy SFAB vs Modern RFB Silicon Lottery Under Non-H TL082IDR (Table 9-1, p.28)" (p.28). BOM decision: Choose MC33202DR2G when single-supply ADC headroom demands full Rail-to-Rail I/O swing; choose TL082IDR when supply rails exceed 12 V (rated up to 40 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 5.25 MHz GBWP. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.5) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
